info.name: MVMNT Saved Searches API
info.description:
The MVMNT API enables you to automate freight brokerage workflows by integrating
directly with our Transportation Management System.

Contact Support:
 Name: MVMNT Support
 Email: support@mvmnt.io

request.description:
Filter saved searches using comprehensive query criteria with AND/OR logic and multiple operators.
Supports complex filtering similar to GraphQL capabilities.
Returns only saved searches accessible to the authenticated user (either owned by them or public).
